name: m3-04-1
title: Abstract base classes
spec:
flowchart TD Typing["Python Interface & Type Checking Models (Fluent Python Chapter 13)"] --> Duck["1. Duck Typing (Runtime)
Call methods directly (len, __getitem__)"] Typing --> Goose["2. Goose Typing (Runtime ABCs)
abc.ABC, @abstractmethod, isinstance(x, Sequence)"] Typing --> Nominal["3. Static Nominal Typing (mypy/pyright)
Explicit class/ABC inheritance & annotations"] Typing --> StaticDuck["4. Static Duck Typing (typing.Protocol)
Structural conformance without inheritance"]

name: m3-05-1
title: Mechanics
spec:
flowchart TD Try["Execute try: block"] --> Check{"Exception raised?"} Check -->|No| Else["Run else: block
(only if try succeeded)"] Check -->|Yes| Match{"Matches except Exc as var?"} Match -->|Yes| Handler["Run except block
(sys.exception() / var.__cause__)
then auto-run: del var"] Match -->|No| FinallyUnwind["Run finally: block
and propagate exception upward"] Else --> FinallyOk["Run finally: block
and continue after try"] Handler --> FinallyOk

name: m3-06-1
title: Concepts
spec:
flowchart TD Work{"What dominates runtime?"} -->|I/O-Bound: Waiting on network, BMCs, APIs, disk| Scale{"Concurrency scale & library support?"} Scale -->|"10 to 200 concurrent calls
(blocking libs: requests, paramiko, boto3)"| TPE["ThreadPoolExecutor
(GIL released during OS I/O)"] Scale -->|"1,000 to 10,000+ connections
(async libs: httpx.AsyncClient, aiohttp, asyncpg)"| AsyncIO["asyncio Event Loop + Semaphore
(offload disk/sync calls via asyncio.to_thread)"] Work -->|CPU-Bound: Parsing, hashing, math, compression| Kind{"Pure Python or Native C/Rust/CUDA?"} Kind -->|"Pure Python (is_prime, AST/JSON transforms)"| PPE["ProcessPoolExecutor / multiprocessing
(1 process per physical core, separate GILs)"] Kind -->|"Native C/CUDA (NumPy, PyTorch, hashlib, zlib)"| Native["Vectorized / Native Calls
(release GIL in C or use process-per-GPU torchrun)"]

name: m3-07-1
title: Architecture: from WSGI to ASGI
spec:
flowchart LR
  C["Client / Ingress / API gateway"] --> S["ASGI server\nuvicorn (uvloop, httptools)"]
  S --> M["Middleware stack\n(CORS, auth, logging, metrics, gzip)"]
  M --> R["Router: match path + method"]
  R --> D["Dependencies (Depends)\nauth, settings, DB session"]
  D --> V["Validate request\n(pydantic)"]
  V --> H["Endpoint function\nasync def or def"]
  H --> O["Validate/serialize response\n(response_model)"]
  O --> C

name: m3-09-1
title: Test strategy for infrastructure code
spec:
flowchart TB
  E2E["End-to-end / canary\n(real cluster, few tests, slow, flaky-prone)"]
  INT["Integration\n(containers, kind, localstack, real DB)"]
  CON["Contract\n(API schemas, recorded fixtures, consumer-driven)"]
  UNIT["Unit\n(pure logic, fakes, milliseconds, thousands)"]
  UNIT --> CON --> INT --> E2E

name: m3-09-2
title: Pipeline architecture
spec:
flowchart LR
  A["Push / PR"] --> B["Lint + format + types\n(fast, fail early)"]
  B --> C["Unit tests\n(matrix: Python 3.10-3.12, OS)"]
  C --> D["Integration tests\n(containers, kind)"]
  D --> E["Build wheel / image\n+ SBOM + scan"]
  E --> F["Publish on tag\n(trusted publishing, signed)"]
  C --> G["Coverage + artefacts"]
